page.overview:
What is Galactic Corporate Policy League?

The Galactic Corporate Policy League was a lobbyist group whose efforts, backed by some key senators of the Galactic Republic, led to the creation of the Corporate Sector at some point before 132 BBY. Notable charter members and key signatories included the Trade Federation, Tagge Company, the Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation, Kuat Drive Yards, Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals, and Cybot Galactica.

In the current Star Wars canon, the Galactic Corporate Policy League was mentioned in the 2025 reference book Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide, which was written by Pablo Hidalgo.
